about.title: About Sito Compras
about.body:
At Sito Compras, we believe shopping should be simple and organized. Create shopping lists, add products, and keep everything tidy in one place.

Built by <2>sito8943, our goal is to help you plan and manage your shopping smoothly, safely, and without complications.

And the best part: it's completely free. Because organizing your life shouldn't cost you anything.

howTo.title: What you can do
howTo.body: With Sito Compras, you have everything you need to organize your shopping lists and items with simple, powerful tools.

steps.title: Currencies
items: Edit details like name or symbol.
Delete the ones you don't use.
View all your currencies in one place.

steps.title: Lists
items: Create shopping lists for different needs (groceries, party, travel).
Rename or update list details anytime.
Delete lists you no longer need.
View and organize all your lists clearly.

steps.title: Product Categories
items: Create categories to group products (e.g., Fruits, Cleaning).
Edit names and descriptions to match your needs.
See all categories for a clear overview.

steps.title: Products
items: Add products with name, quantity, price and category.
Delete products you no longer need.
Review items across your lists easily.
